title: buildingSMART IFC 4.3.2.0 / ISO 16739-1:2024
bounded_claim: Latest official IFC is 4.3.2.0, published as ISO 16739-1:2024, defining vendor-neutral built-asset/BIM schemas across asset lifecycles.
authority_limit: IFC does not define generic CAD/B-rep mathematical topology or application authorization; serialization is separable from IFC semantics.
negative_twin: BIM semantic model != STEP serialization != generic CAD kernel

title: DICOM PS3.3/PS3.4 2026c
bounded_claim: Defines DICOM information objects and the Patient/Study/Series/Composite Instance hierarchy with explicit UIDs and information entities.
authority_limit: DICOM information hierarchy does not establish clinical truth, diagnosis, report acceptance or storage-provider identity.
negative_twin: DICOM instance != clinical finding != accepted diagnosis

title: HL7 FHIR R5 5.0.0 resource and reference model
bounded_claim: FHIR R5 defines resource identity, literal/logical/canonical references and version-specific references; resources form an explicitly directed web of information.
authority_limit: FHIR resource identity/reference semantics do not by themselves define domain equality, clinical authority or cross-version equivalence.
negative_twin: FHIR resource reference != domain identity equivalence

title: ISO 20022-1:2026 Financial services — Universal financial industry message scheme — Part 1: Metamodel
bounded_claim: Edition 3, published April 2026, defines a common metamodel for business processes, data elements and financial messages with enhanced versioning and traceability.
authority_limit: The metamodel does not collapse a business message into settlement, accounting state or transport/session semantics.
negative_twin: financial message != transaction settlement != ledger posting

title: FIX Trading Community technical standards
bounded_claim: FIX explicitly separates application-layer FIX Latest from session layers, encodings, framing and transports; the classic session is an ordered durable sequence-number stream with recovery/resynchronization.
authority_limit: FIX session order/recovery does not make business processing exactly-once and application messages do not equal venue or accounting state.
negative_twin: FIX session sequence != business occurrence identity

title: FITS Standard 4.0
bounded_claim: Official FITS reference version 4.0 defines requirements for FITS data files, including recognized time-coordinate and image/table conventions.
authority_limit: FITS file/HDU structure does not define scientific interpretation or observation acceptance.
negative_twin: FITS HDU != scientific phenomenon

title: HDF5 File Format Specification Version 4.0
bounded_claim: Current HDF5 format specification maps the abstract object/data model to storage, including groups, links, object headers and dataset representation.
authority_limit: HDF5 storage graph does not own domain-array coordinates, scientific variables or dataset semantics.
negative_twin: HDF5 group/dataset != domain dataset meaning

title: Unidata netCDF data model
bounded_claim: NetCDF distinguishes the classic variables/dimensions/attributes model and the enhanced model with groups and user-defined types.
authority_limit: NetCDF storage/data model alone does not define climate/forecast coordinate semantics; those belong to conventions such as CF.
negative_twin: netCDF data model != CF semantic coordinate model

title: CF Metadata Conventions 1.13
bounded_claim: Released December 2025, CF 1.13 defines climate/forecast metadata conventions including time coordinates/calendars, spatial grid mappings and scientific variable semantics over netCDF-style arrays.
authority_limit: CF conventions do not own netCDF physical storage or scientific inference/acceptance.
negative_twin: coordinate metadata != storage layout != scientific conclusion

title: Khronos glTF 2.0.1
bounded_claim: Current formal glTF version remains 2.0/2.0.1 and defines a runtime-neutral 3D asset delivery format; glTF 2.1 complex-scene composition was announced in June 2026 as future/backward-compatible work.
authority_limit: glTF representation/profile authority does not equal generic scene semantics or BIM/digital-twin authority.
negative_twin: glTF asset representation != semantic scene/digital twin

title: OpenEXR technical deep-data model
bounded_claim: Deep images store a variable-length list of samples at each pixel and distinguish deep scanline/tile data from flat/multichannel imagery.
authority_limit: Deep-pixel/sample representation does not define compositing truth, scene identity or physical depth truth.
negative_twin: deep sample topology != scene object identity

title: GA4GH Variation Representation Specification v2.0
bounded_claim: Current VRS v2.0 provides a protocol-neutral modular data model for precise computational representation/exchange of biological sequence variation.
authority_limit: Variation representation does not own clinical interpretation, recommendation or variant-call evidence quality.
negative_twin: variant representation != clinical interpretation

title: GA4GH Phenopackets v2.0
bounded_claim: Phenopackets v2.0 structures clinical/phenotypic information and interoperates with genomic standards such as VRS and FHIR.
authority_limit: Phenopacket representation does not establish phenotype truth, diagnosis or clinical acceptance.
negative_twin: phenotype packet != diagnosis

title: GA4GH HTS SAM/BAM/CRAM and related format specifications
bounded_claim: Maintains canonical SAM/BAM/CRAM alignment specifications and explicitly does not define a dedicated unaligned-read format, recommending alignment formats with unmapped state.
authority_limit: Alignment/read representation does not establish biological identity, variant truth or sequencing-quality acceptance.
negative_twin: unaligned read occurrence != alignment != variant call

title: OGC STAC Community Standard 1.1.0
bounded_claim: STAC 1.1.0 standardizes Item/Catalog/Collection/Asset metadata for spatiotemporal assets with a minimal extensible core.
authority_limit: STAC catalog metadata does not own the semantic meaning or truth of the referenced asset.
negative_twin: catalog item/asset metadata != asset semantic content

title: W3C DCAT 3
bounded_claim: DCAT 3 explicitly distinguishes CatalogRecord, Resource, Dataset, Distribution and DataService; a Distribution is a representation/access form of a conceptual Dataset.
authority_limit: Catalog metadata/registration does not own dataset semantic truth or service behavior.
negative_twin: catalog record != dataset != distribution

title: RFC 5322 Internet Message Format
bounded_claim: Defines Internet message header/body syntax and explicitly separates delivered message contents from the transmission/delivery envelope governed by SMTP.
authority_limit: Message syntax does not define SMTP transaction state, mailbox occurrence identity or application-thread semantics.
negative_twin: message content != SMTP envelope != mailbox occurrence

title: RFC 9051 IMAP4rev2
bounded_claim: Defines mailbox message access using sequence numbers and durable mailbox-scoped UID/UIDVALIDITY semantics, making sequence position distinct from stable mailbox occurrence identity.
authority_limit: IMAP mailbox occurrence identity does not imply global message identity or conversation-thread identity.
negative_twin: mailbox UID != RFC message identity != thread

title: RFC 5545 iCalendar
bounded_claim: Defines calendar components and recurrence sets using DTSTART/RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE with explicit time-zone and invalid-occurrence behavior.
authority_limit: Generic recurrence does not define enterprise business-day/holiday/work-shift policy.
negative_twin: recurrence algebra != business calendar policy

title: RFC 7516 JSON Web Encryption
bounded_claim: Defines encrypted/integrity-protected JWE logical structures including protected headers, encrypted key, IV, AAD, ciphertext and authentication tag.
authority_limit: Cryptographic envelope validity does not establish payload semantic truth or authorization.
negative_twin: verified protected envelope != trusted business claim

title: RFC 9052 COSE structures and process
bounded_claim: Internet Standard defining CBOR signing, MAC and encryption object structures and processing.
authority_limit: COSE verification result does not equal semantic appraisal or action authorization.
negative_twin: cryptographic verification != semantic acceptance

title: ISO 4217:2015 currency codes, maintained registry
bounded_claim: Defines maintained alphabetic/numeric currency codes and minor-unit relationships for currencies, funds and precious metals.
authority_limit: Currency identity/minor units do not define money valuation, exchange-rate authority, accounting policy or legal tender status at a time/place.
negative_twin: currency code != monetary amount policy != valuation

title: ECMWF ecCodes edition-independent forecast time keys
bounded_claim: Separates forecast reference date/time, start/end forecast step, step type and resulting validity date/time.
authority_limit: Forecast temporal coordinates do not define model selection, override, publication approval or decision authority.
negative_twin: forecast issue/reference time != validity time != publication decision

title: MiniZinc 2.10.0 language/reference specification
bounded_claim: Current MiniZinc release provides a solver-independent constraint/optimization modeling language and solver interface specification.
authority_limit: A model/solver interface does not establish objective authority, business selection or physical action.
negative_twin: constraint model != selected business plan

title: MIPLIB 2017
bounded_claim: Established common benchmark corpus for pure and mixed-integer programs and optimizer comparison.
authority_limit: Benchmark instances/results cover MIP performance, not all operations-research formalisms or business objective authority.
negative_twin: benchmark optimum != governed decision

title: Functional Mock-up Interface 3.0.2
bounded_claim: Defines model exchange, co-simulation and scheduled-execution interfaces for dynamic simulation models.
authority_limit: Simulation interface/model execution does not establish real-world prediction truth or decision authority.
negative_twin: simulation run != observed outcome

title: DIMACS Implementation Challenges
bounded_claim: Independent benchmark/challenge program covers multiple optimization/problem classes; 2026-2027 challenge targets Network Flows 2.0.
authority_limit: Challenge benchmark performance does not define model meaning or optimality certificates for unrelated formalisms.
negative_twin: algorithm benchmark result != semantic fitness

title: TMF621 Trouble Ticket Management API v5.0
bounded_claim: Defines a stable trouble-ticket lifecycle/API for creating, tracking and managing issues among systems/partners.
authority_limit: Trouble ticket lifecycle is distinct from service problem, incident evidence and remediation effect.
negative_twin: trouble ticket != service problem != incident cause

title: TMF656 Service Problem Management API v5.1 preview / v5 stable lineage
bounded_claim: Defines service-problem management distinct from alarms, performance anomalies, trouble tickets, SLA violations, maintenance and predictions that may feed it.
authority_limit: Service-problem record does not collapse its evidence inputs or corrective execution.
negative_twin: alarm/ticket != service problem != correction

title: TMF676 Payment Management API v4.0
bounded_claim: Defines payment and refund model/operations as separate performed occurrences.
authority_limit: Payment/refund API occurrence does not equal invoice, rating, settlement finality or accounting posting.
negative_twin: payment/refund record != invoice != ledger posting

title: TMF678 Customer Bill Management API v5.0
bounded_claim: Defines customer bills/invoices and applied billing rates, including bill creation request lifecycle.
authority_limit: Bill/invoice lifecycle does not own payment/refund, product catalog or accounting posting semantics.
negative_twin: bill != payment != accounting posting
